rules.note: an actor the engine reports at or below the threshold holds position
otherwise take the engine-offered legal Move

player.note: Conditioned only on engine-read facts: the actor's own HP percent and which commands the menu offers.

note: A5.3 live-conditional preset, calibrated to the A4 two-ally fixture (Marche 100%, Montblanc 73% at battle start) so one run exercises both rules with contrasting decisions. The threshold is an ordinary policy value, not an engine field. Move carries no destination and no MP cost at this stage, so this is a condition on the actor's own state, not a targeting policy.
